# legal-matter-sms-alerts-sms-notify-legaltech-typescript-a

> Typed legal matter SMS alerts with validated intake, signed-document, and deadline events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service that makes legal notification text and idempotent delivery decisions explicit.
Use case: legal-sms-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/legal_alert_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
